tokens.v: Catch it at the top of a real toss, tumbling nose-down at a three-quarter tilt with the gum tread swinging toward the lens, both laces whipped into an arc and smeared while the weave stays razor sharp. A fine veil of dry chalk dust punches off the outsole and curls through the rim, every mote catching it before the falloff swallows them. 85mm at f/3.5, camera just below it and looking up; a lace tip crosses the bottom-left corner soft and is cut by it.
